# Carrom upstream source notice

Upstream repository: https://github.com/sasidharreddy-janke/Carrom-Game-

Files retained in this directory are source snapshots from the upstream repository. Its README states that the project is under the MIT License, but the repository tree inspected for this release did not contain a separate LICENSE file. Review the upstream repository's current licensing terms before redistributing this source outside NEXUS PLAY.

NEXUS PLAY uses the upstream physics implementation as an isolated server-side simulation source and keeps its Liquid Glass UI separate from the game source.
